lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: I know! I didn't even notice until we got you onto the dock. I just needed to get you out of the water.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You really carried me all the way back?

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: Of course. We can figure out the... legs part later. I'm just glad you're awake.

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: Yeah, apparently. I noticed halfway up. Kind of hard to care when you weren't breathing.

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: We'll figure that weirdness out later. Don't scare me like that again.
